title: Step 2 Phase 5 Rule Conversion Plan

planningMethodology.semanticBasis: Use the completed semantic inventory; conversion planning does not repeat or claim new discovery.
planningMethodology.complexity: Score uses entry roots, capped nested paths, distinct patterns, gaps, dependencies, and semantic observations. Nested path count is workload evidence, not a count of mechanics. Complex multi-procedure records receive explicit overrides.

complexityBands.VERY_HIGH: roots >=10, nested >=250, roots >=6 and nested >=100, patterns >=7, or listed multi-procedure outlier

approaches.A_EXISTING_PATTERN_CONVERSION: Existing patterns appear to represent observed mechanics; verify source clauses.
approaches.B_MIXED_STRUCTURED_AND_REFERENCE_ONLY: Some mechanics map to existing patterns while other clauses need explicit omission, references, or deferral.
approaches.C_REFERENCE_ONLY: No confidently reusable structured mechanic is identified; source check required before emitting reference-only record.
approaches.D_NEEDS_SOURCE_LEVEL_INVESTIGATION: Semantic summary is too aggregated for safe mapping; direct clause review is scheduled, not a schema extension.

planningMethodology.dependencyMethod: Pending-to-pending canonical Rule dependencies in the reviewed semantic inventory are ordered target-before-consumer. Strongly connected records are co-batched. Dependencies on already accounted or external identities remain per-record validation obligations.
planningMethodology.batchSizing: Ordinary groups cap at 16 records/110 planning points; groups containing HIGH work cap at 7 records/75 points; VERY_HIGH outliers are isolated. Grouping is theme-coherent subject to dependency order.
planningMethodology.gapBoundary: No schema changes. Existing deferred/skipped gap classifications are retained in each record plan.

validationChecklist: Reconcile planned identity and source path to immutable catalog and current accounting.
Inspect complete source object, entry roots, nested procedures, tables, structured fields, exceptions, and exact references.
Use only currently approved Rule/shared schemas; preserve edition and source differences.
Use reference-only identity only after source review confirms no meaningful supported mechanics can be represented.
Account for every entry root and applicable nested clause as INTERPRETED, DUPLICATE, or OMITTED with approved reasons.
Update restricted source registers and accurately classify FULL/PARTIAL/UNSUPPORTED from represented mechanics.
Add source-backed semantic checks for important values/relationships; validate IDs, schemas, references, accounting, registers, and totals.
Run npm run validate:core-rules and git diff --check; stop at a consistent human-review checkpoint.

risks.description: The current validator may require a complete Rule catalog at each checkpoint.
risks.mitigation: Inspect before Batch 1; if incremental counts block validation, request a bounded checkpoint-aware validator change, do not weaken completeness checks.

risks.description: Semantic observations summarize rather than replace source reading.
risks.mitigation: Read complete source in each batch, especially high/very-high chapters.

risks.description: External domain references may not yet resolve.
risks.mitigation: Preserve exact IDs and use approved unresolved/external dispositions; do not invent targets.

risks.description: Deferred and skipped gaps affect coverage.
risks.mitigation: Interpret independent supported mechanics and account for unresolved parts without implementing deferred gaps.

manifestNamingIssue.recommendation: In a separately authorized manifest correction, rename or replace this conflated field with pendingConversionAccountingCount and set semanticPendingReviewCount to zero. Do not modify the manifest during planning.
